description.value: McDonald's is a globally recognized fast-food chain offering burgers, chicken sandwiches, breakfast items, and McCafé beverages. This Cliffe Avenue location serves the Courtenay area of Vancouver Island and includes a drive-through alongside dine-in and takeout service. It is a reliable, predictable food stop for touring cyclists passing through the Comox Valley corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (8 spaces) at 29m. Total: 8 spaces.
